asserts: The approval hash the stack signs for identity's privileged doors is the one svc-identity recomputes.
why: Calls svc-identity's identityActionPayloadHash and the tool's identityPayloadHash on the same inputs and requires equal hashes.

asserts: svc-identity's kyc.approve consumes exactly kycApproveProposal for the record.
why: Calls the identity router's kyc.approve through createCaller with an MFA admin:compliance principal and a recording consumer, and requires the consume request to equal kycApproveProposal's.

asserts: The approval hash the stack signs for bank ops is the one svc-bank recomputes (fields sorted by key).
why: Calls svc-bank's bankActionPayloadHash and the tool's bankPayloadHash on the same inputs, and drives consumeBankOpsApprovalPair to read what bank consumes.

asserts: The stack's transfer-terms proposal names svc-bank's publish action and binds the fields svc-bank normalises.

guard.ref: tooling/scripts/local-test-gates.test.mjs#${t.assetId}: the terms proposal is not what svc-bank consumes

why: Imports PUBLISH_TRANSFER_TERMS_ACTION and publishTransferTermsFields, and requires each TEST row's termsProposal to equal what consumeBankOpsApprovalPair asks to consume for them.

asserts: The stack's fraud-listing approval names svc-bank's action and the fields svc-bank normalises, so its hash is the one svc-bank recomputes.

guard.ref: tooling/scripts/local-test-gates.test.mjs#fraud listing approval fields changed; update fraudListingFields

why: Compares SET_FRAUD_LISTING_ACTION and svc-bank's own fraudListingFields with the tool's on the same inputs (including every TEST_FRAUD_LIST row) and the consumed hash.

asserts: The asset-edit proposal names the action type and target service svc-ledger consumes.
why: Imports ASSET_EDIT_ACTION_TYPE and ASSET_EDIT_TARGET_SERVICE from the shared contract and requires the proposal to carry them.

asserts: The gates never send a TOTP step further ahead than identity's default skew window accepts.

guard.ref: tooling/scripts/local-test-gates.test.mjs#the gates look ahead no further than identity's skew window

why: Generates codes with identity's totp() and requires matchTotpStep, with its default window, to accept the step TOTP_SKEW_STEPS ahead and refuse the one after.

asserts: apply waits exactly as long as Edge's authority cache can hold a session's tier.

guard.ref: tooling/scripts/local-test-gates.test.mjs#the gates wait exactly as long as Edge's authority cache can hold a session's tier

why: Imports Edge's AUTHORITY_POSITIVE_CACHE_MAX_MS and requires it to equal EDGE_AUTHORITY_CACHE_MAX_MS.

asserts: Identity holds ledger.freeze and ledger.unfreeze approvals for founders, as the posting-freeze proposals assume.
why: Calls identity's audienceOfApproval on both posting-freeze proposals and requires 'founder'.

asserts: engine-drop takes the cancel from svc-trade's own durable consumer of matching's orderCancelled.

guard.ref: tooling/scripts/local-test-gates.test.mjs#trade's cancel consumer is the one named

why: Calls svc-trade's subscribeMatchingEvents with a recording bus and requires orderCancelled's durable to be TRADE_CANCELS.durable.

asserts: A cookie scoped-session seals opens in the console: same cookie name, cipher, AAD (name, origin, v1) and session keys.
why: Seals with sealConsoleSession and opens with the console's openFounderSession; another origin, another key or another key set is refused admin.session_required.
